title: Multi-target antibacterial Ru-based metallodrugs containing phenylsulfonyl indole derivatives: synthesis and their efficacy against Gram-positive and -negative bacteria
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21284-21299
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03098F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shijie Lin, Guangying Yu, Liu Zhang, Xiangwen Liao, Guijuan Jiang, Lianghong Liu
A multi-target antibacterial Ru-based metallodrug containing phenylsulfonyl indole derivative (RuS2) can destroy the bacterial membrane and induce the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and showed significant anti-infective potency in vivo.
